nodes.label: Envelope Budgeting
nodes.rationale: Assign income to category envelopes, watch Ready to Assign, move money between envelopes, roll balances across months, persist envelope-to-envelope transfers.

nodes.label: Mission Control
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted, YNAB-style personal finance dashboard. Envelope budgeting, expense tracking, subscriptions, investments. Working title 'YNAB Replacement'.

nodes.label: Auto-categorization
nodes.rationale: Keyword-to-category map learned from past expenses (/api/category-map); LLM fallback via Gemini at /api/category-map/suggest.

nodes.label: Transactions
nodes.rationale: Inline entry, edit and recategorize from UI, click envelope to filter log, auto-category suggestions.

nodes.label: Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Track services and amounts, cancel/reactivate, next-due dates.

nodes.label: Investments
nodes.rationale: Holdings and net worth, market updates, contributions/withdrawals, event log.

nodes.label: Money Brain (AI)
nodes.rationale: Gemini-powered chat about spending (/api/ai/chat, streamed, rate-limited), daily brief cards (/api/ai/brief), cron transaction scan flagging anomalies with push notifications.

nodes.label: Push Notifications
nodes.rationale: Expo push tokens per device; weekly spend digest and AI scan alerts via cron-only /api/notifications/run (CRON_SECRET).

nodes.label: Wrapped Recap
nodes.rationale: /api/wrapped computes the year-in-review payload the mobile Wrapped screen renders.

nodes.label: Account & Security
nodes.rationale: Email change with 6-digit verification, linked identities (Google/email), active-session list with remote revoke, delete account, data export (CSV/JSON).

nodes.label: Onboarding Tour
nodes.rationale: 3-slide walkthrough shown once per account after first sign-in, tracked via onboardedAt on user doc.

nodes.label: Theme Preferences
nodes.rationale: Light/dark theme persisted per account.

nodes.label: Fitness & Learnings Pages
nodes.rationale: Experiments on bundled sample data, not real product surfaces. Finance-first: budget/expenses/investments are the product; fitness and learnings are garnish.

nodes.label: Read-only Demo Account
nodes.rationale: DEMO_USER_ID is backend fallback scope for requests without a session; just another user_id, no separate demo_* mirror collections. Every non-GET from it returns 403.

nodes.label: user_id Data Scoping
nodes.rationale: Tenancy enforced at the choke point, not per handler: ScopedCollection injects user_id into every filter and stamps every insert (incl. bulkWrite). Caches keyed by user id too.

nodes.label: MongoDB Data Layer
nodes.rationale: MongoDB (Atlas or local) single store; collections mirror old CSV files. lib/models.ts keeps legacy CSV header/snake_case names so { headers, rows } shape survives unchanged.

nodes.label: WorkOS AuthKit
nodes.rationale: Never through WorkOS hosted UI: Google goes straight to Google consent screen, email uses magic-auth codes, both via app/api/auth/* calling saveSession() directly.

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment
nodes.rationale: vercel.json pins framework preset to nextjs so the .next build output is used automatically.

nodes.label: CSV to MongoDB Migration
nodes.rationale: DB seeded from local CSVs (productivity/, data/ gitignored; only demo/ ships). Natural-keyed collections upsert in place; append-only logs cleared and re-inserted.

nodes.label: Route vs View Layer Split
nodes.rationale: app/ is route layer only (thin page wrappers + app/api server logic), src/ holds real frontend (views, components, context, services/adapters, types), lib/ server helpers. mission-control-app/ legacy prototype, superseded.

nodes.label: app/api Route Handlers
nodes.rationale: CSV-era /api/* endpoints now MongoDB-backed; each request resolves owning user id (real or demo) via lib/access.ts::getAuth.

nodes.label: ScopedCollection Choke Point
nodes.rationale: getCollection(base, auth) returns ScopedCollection injecting user_id into every filter/insert. New API routes must use getCollection, never db.collection() directly.

nodes.label: getAuth Resolver
nodes.rationale: Resolves Auth ({ userId, readOnly }) per request: Bearer JWT vs WorkOS JWKS (mobile), AuthKit session cookie via withAuth() (web, token never reaches browser JS), then read-only demo user.

nodes.label: middleware.ts Session Gating
nodes.rationale: Gates every page except /sign-in, /email, /code behind session cookie; /api/* never gated by middleware. Refreshes cookie but never forces sign-in.

nodes.label: Principle: Answer the money question in seconds
nodes.rationale: Dashboard is a cockpit, not a form maze — read state at a glance and act (assign, move, recategorize) directly.

nodes.label: Principle: Privacy by default
nodes.rationale: Real financial data stays in own store; guests and demos only see curated sample data. Personal data private by design, never committed.

nodes.label: Principle: Direct manipulation over workflow
nodes.rationale: Inline entry, click-to-filter, move-money-within-reach outrank wizard-style flows.

nodes.label: INR Monthly Money Cycle
nodes.rationale: Currency INR formatted en-IN. Salary credited 4th, income assigned to envelopes, fixed investment sweep plus spendable pool. Rent, subscriptions, food, travel/commute, football are heavy categories.

nodes.label: users collection
nodes.rationale: Holds WorkOS-account metadata (email, name) for attaching app-specific data; synced JIT via ensureUser()/ensureUserById(), not webhooks. Metadata only — JWT sub is the tenant key.
